source: Working translation by the pack's own contributor. No official English version of the Law on Value Added Tax's implementing regulations, of the FBiH Pravilnik o kontnom okviru or of the Pravilnik o sadržaju i formi obrazaca finansijskih izvještaja exists, other than the Law on VAT itself, of which the Indirect Taxation Authority (UIO) publishes an official English translation cited in pack.json; see i18n/README.md.
